_doc: power-guard (Power and Jobs Sizing). Tightens CPU power caps through Dashboard's /api/throttle (lower-only, self-expiring). A combined over steps BOTH servers at once, ~step_w from each, set below each server's actual draw (GPU server pkg cap = actual pkg W - step_w/2; hub DCMI = peak - step_w). An GPU server-only over steps only the GPU server. Also steps the GPU server GPU power limit (gpu_step_w, floor gpu_floor_w, below the profile limit) and steps every cap back UP when peaks stay up_margin_w under the line for up_hold_s (2026-10-01). Never touches jobs. Live-editable.
